metadata.layer: Layer 3D — Four Deep Internal Knots (Openers, 740 Chains, 705/706->033 Anomaly, Pottery Graffiti)

verdict.city_evidence: 4-Opener x 6 Major Cities chi2=16.491, p_asym=0.35019, p_MC=0.35066, Cramer's V=0.119 — statistically uniform across all cities.
verdict.animal_totem_1to1_hypothesis: FALSIFIED (omnibus p=0.238, V=0.157; minor 1-vs-3 signal: 820->Rhin 5x, p=0.0098)
verdict.chronological_dynasty_hypothesis: FALSIFIED (period p=0.879, V=0.120; phase p=0.349, V=0.160 — all 4 co-exist)
verdict.supported_interpretation: PAN-HARAPPAN ELITE INSTITUTIONAL / CULTIC / DIVINE-INVOCATION DETERMINATIVES: All 4 openers are mutually exclusive with one another, uniformly distributed across all 6 major Indus cities (V=0.119, p=0.35019), significantly enriched on square steatite administrative seals (SEAL:S 284/411 (69.1%) vs rest 874/1636 (53.4%), lift=1.29x, p=8.521e-09), Bull1_Unicorn (234/411 (56.9%) vs 675/1636 (41.3%), lift=1.38x, p=1.319e-08), and SAN cult stands (135/411 (32.8%) vs 363/1636 (22.2%), lift=1.48x, p=1.154e-05), while sharply splitting on immediate grammatical right-neighbors (817/861->002; 920->060; 820->002+060; chi2=280.457, V=0.4769, p=4.9436e-49).

knot2_740_reduplication_and_suffix_chain.verdict: Agglutinative suffix template strongly ordered 740 -> 090 -> 400: pairwise locks are 740->090=124:2 (98.4%, p=1.881e-34), 740->400=247:15 (94.3%, p=2.747e-55), 090->400=16:1 (94.1%, p=0.0002747); 3-sign stack 740->090->400 occurs 9x vs 0x for 740->400->090, 090->740->400, and 400->090->740 (while 400->740->090=3x and 090->400->740=1x occur at clause boundaries like 554.2 `090 400 740 090 400`). Exact full-line block reduplication A -> 740 -> A occurs on Harappa TAB:B 554.2 (`090 400 740 090 400`), parallel double-clause `[692 060 ... 740] [692 060 ... 740]` occurs on Mohenjo-daro seals 2214.1 & 3077.1, confirming 740 as a productive genitive/possessive linker stacking with human/agentive 090 and comb 400.

knot3_705_706_033_anomaly.verdict: DECISIVELY A FROZEN 2-SIGN COMPOUND STEM / TITLE, NOT A POTTERY MEASURE: (1) Rigidly unidirectional 87:0 in deduplicated strict sequences (p=1.29e-26) and 149:0 corpus-wide (p=2.80e-45); (2) Layer 1B proves 705 & 706 are visual+distributional allographs (cooc=0), making 705/706->033 one unified morpheme; (3) Occurs 96x on seals + 49x on tablets (incl. 31 Hare/Elephant copper tablets TAB:C) vs 0x on incised pottery graffiti POT:T:g (p=2.31e-09; the sole pottery hit is a seal-stamped POT:T:s); (4) 77.8% (91/117, lift=9.2x, p=2.15e-72) of non-initial occurrences attach immediately after the Fish-sign family (220–240), and 49/149 (32.9%) terminate in Arrow 520!

knot4_pottery_graffiti_vs_steatite_seals.verdict: Harappan pottery splits sharply into TWO functional registers: (1) Incised graffiti POT:T:g (539 lines) is 58.07% single-sign potter's/owner's marks (mean len=1.677), whereas seal-stamped pottery POT:T:s (73 lines) is only 46.58% single-sign (mean len=1.795, Fisher p=4.19e-02); (2) 86.11% (186/216) of pottery signs belong to the exact same core Indus script as steatite seals, yet pottery specifically enriches vessel/measure/stroke signs (034=032+032 14.3x, 480 8.7x, 700 basin 4.6x, 697=700+700+700 triple-basin 6x vs 0x on seals, 515 10x vs 0x on seals) while massively depleting elite seal grammar (740 Jar, 817/820/861/920 openers, 705/706->033).
